block_rule: each queried target is one singleton block; no arithmetic multi-gene target mean
compute_separation: unqueried hidden genes remain hidden; a smaller query budget changes estimator variance/compute, never student evidence
mass_rule: uniform query sampling is an unbiased Monte Carlo estimator of the mean singleton loss over the complete hidden target set
query_identity: authority_seed + frozen base_presentation_index + stable_cell_key + family + draw; optimizer update/microbatch position excluded
query_rule: uniform finite sample of singleton canonical molecular addresses from the already-hidden set
scientific_hidden_rule: the complete family half-mask is hidden from the student irrespective of query budget
